decisions.reason: It fits the firm's office and conference strengths well, and as a new multi-model line the option value of waiting for clearer market feedback is still high.
This chair family is close to the core offer and can be kept on the market at relatively low incremental cost while the firm learns about demand.
The floor cushions are more peripheral than the core furniture lines, but their design fit and likely modest carrying cost make continued testing worthwhile for now.
Its weak website prominence compared with the other launches and the firm's many adjacent alternatives suggest this option has the lowest revealed value and is the likeliest to be abandoned.
The high standing table matches the move toward flexible contemporary workplaces and remains a sensible adjacent option to keep open.
Although more distant from the established offer, its flagship role in the firm's direction toward holistic interiors justifies keeping it longer to resolve uncertainty.
